2607.12801.title: Autonomous Tracking and Terminal Guidance of Moving Targets for Fixed-Wing UAVs
2607.12801.paper_summary: This study introduces a unified control framework for fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) fitted with a pan-tilt (PT) camera, intended to perform an end-to-end mission spanning from initial target detection to accurate terminal engagement. The proposed system employs a three-phase strategy: a vision-based target acquisition phase, an NMPC-based tracking phase, and a terminal guidance phase. During tracking, the framework uses an Unscented Kalman Filter (UKF) to fuse YOLO-based visual detections with inertial measurements, enabling robust target state estimation under unknown dynamics. To ensure reliable visual contact, we introduce a constraint-aware Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) strategy that incorporates Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) to explicitly prevent UAV self-occlusion -- a common limitation in fixed-wing tracking. Upon satisfying terminal engagement conditions, the system seamlessly transitions control to a quaternion-based Biased Proportional Navigation Guidance (BPNG) law, enforcing precise impact angle constraints. High-fidelity simulations demonstrate that the framework achieves stable, robust tracking and accurate terminal interception while strictly respecting the vehicle's dynamic limits and camera field-of-view constraints.
2607.12801.paper_summary_zh: 這項研究介紹了一個統一的控制框架，適用於配備有平移-俯仰（PT）相機的固定翼無人機（UAV），旨在執行從初始目標檢測到準確終端接觸的端到端任務。所提出的系統採用三階段策略：基於視覺的目標獲取階段、基於非線性模型預測控制（NMPC）的跟踪階段以及終端引導階段。在跟踪過程中，該框架使用無味卡爾曼濾波器（UKF）將基於YOLO的視覺檢測與慣性測量融合，使得在未知動態下能夠穩健地估計目標狀態。為了確保可靠的視覺接觸，我們引入了一種考慮約束的非線性模型預測控制（NMPC）策略，該策略結合了控制障礙函數（CBFs），明確防止無人機自我遮擋——這是固定翼跟踪中的一個常見限制。在滿足終端接觸條件後，系統無縫地將控制轉移到基於四元數的偏置比例導航引導（BPNG）法，強制執行精確的衝擊角度約束。高保真模擬顯示，該框架實現了穩定、穩健的跟踪和準確的終端攔截，同時嚴格遵守飛行器的動態限制和相機視場約束。
2607.12801.author: Wei-Hao Liou et.al.
